plans.idea: Two-column split like a mini banner: the bottle fills a tall left column, and a right text column reads top to bottom as brand badge, headline and subline, then the CTA, all sharing one left edge.
Headline-first poster: a full-width top band holds the headline and subline at a large size, and below it the bottle sits bottom-left while the badge and CTA stack bottom-right on a shared left edge.
Centred vertical stack on one axis: a small brand badge on top, then a full-width headline and subline, then the bottle as the centrepiece, then the CTA anchoring the bottom.
